summary: Estoicismo a fondo para Janus: los doce libros de las Meditaciones completos (Long, 1862) con resúmenes y búsqueda, historia de la escuela, orígenes grecorromanos, doctrina, psicología actual y ejercicios; cada dato con su base (verificado / consenso / inferencia / no verificado).
invariants: The Meditations has twelve BOOKS (never 'tomos'). Paragraph numbers are positions inside the Standard Ebooks edition, not necessarily the standard book.section numbers.
The full English text of Long's translation is kept byte-checked: the tests recompute a SHA-256 per book against MEDITATIONS_TEXT_SHA256.
Every digest excerpt is an exact substring of the paragraph it points to (checked by the tests). Spanish summaries and glosses are interpretation, never presented as translation.
Every statement carries a basis: verified-source, consensus-unverified, inference or unverified. Dates of people are consensus unless marked otherwise.
Crisis language returns support_first with no quotations or philosophy.
Psychology answers always say: philosophy of life, not a therapy; not the same as or the origin of CBT; not a therapist; see a professional for real difficulties.
Not a clinical tool: no diagnosis, no treatment claims. Evidence for Stoic-based programmes is reported as preliminary (NO VERIFICADO as clinical efficacy).
reuseNotes: Import from src/index.ts. Wrap with a thin adapter in each host product (Janus uses packages/adapters/src/stoicism-tool-adapter.ts). Sibling of seneca-wisdom and marcus-aurelius-wisdom, which stay independent and keep their curated quotes. To refresh the text: regenerate meditations-text.ts and meditations-digests.ts from the source commit named in src/provenance.ts and update the hashes.
